test.create_query: CREATE TABLE mv_plan_source (id UInt64, value Float64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE mv_plan_lookup (id UInt64, a Float64, b Float64, c Float64, d Float64) ENGINE = Memory
CREATE TABLE mv_plan_target (id UInt64, score Float64) ENGINE = Null
test.fill_query: INSERT INTO mv_plan_lookup SELECT number, number * 0.1, number * 0.2, number * 0.3, number * 0.4 FROM numbers(1024)
test.create_query: CREATE MATERIALIZED VIEW mv_plan_view TO mv_plan_target AS WITH base AS ( SELECT s.id AS id, s.value AS value, coalesce(l1.a, 0.) AS a1, coalesce(l2.b, 0.) AS b2, coalesce(l3.c, 0.) AS c3, coalesce(l4.d, 0.) AS d4 FROM mv_plan_source AS s LEFT JOIN mv_plan_lookup AS l1 ON l1.id = s.id % 1024 LEFT JOIN mv_plan_lookup AS l2 ON l2.id = (s.id + 1) % 1024 LEFT JOIN mv_plan_lookup AS l3 ON l3.id = (s.id + 2) % 1024 LEFT JOIN mv_plan_lookup AS l4 ON l4.id = (s.id + 3) % 1024 ), stage1 AS ( SELECT id, value, a1, b2, c3, d4, value + a1 AS s1, value + b2 AS s2, value + c3 AS s3, value + d4 AS s4 FROM base ), stage2 AS ( SELECT x.id AS id, x.value AS value, x.s1 AS s1, x.s2 AS s2, x.s3 AS s3, x.s4 AS s4, coalesce(l5.a, 0.) AS e1, coalesce(l6.b, 0.) AS e2, coalesce(l7.c, 0.) AS e3, coalesce(l8.d, 0.) AS e4 FROM stage1 AS x LEFT JOIN mv_plan_lookup AS l5 ON l5.id = (x.id + 4) % 1024 LEFT JOIN mv_plan_lookup AS l6 ON l6.id = (x.id + 5) % 1024 LEFT JOIN mv_plan_lookup AS l7 ON l7.id = (x.id + 6) % 1024 LEFT JOIN mv_plan_lookup AS l8 ON l8.id = (x.id + 7) % 1024 ), stage3 AS ( SELECT id, (s1 + e1) * (s2 + e2) AS left_score, (s3 + e3) * (s4 + e4) AS right_score FROM stage2 ), stage4 AS ( SELECT x.id AS id, x.left_score AS left_score, x.right_score AS right_score, coalesce(l9.a + l9.b + l9.c + l9.d, 0.) AS tail FROM stage3 AS x LEFT JOIN mv_plan_lookup AS l9 ON l9.id = (x.id + 8) % 1024 ) SELECT id, left_score + right_score + tail AS score FROM stage4
